commentTextItems.html: Length down leg, flicked to midwicket. "Nearly nearly down the leg side," goes the keeper. Pant chuckles
Full on leg, defended to the off side of the pitch with the bat in front
Better ball. Touch back of length on off, punched back to the bowler. 81ks.
Longest of long hops. Room given too. 85ks ball doesn't bounce. Goes at an easy pace. Gill drags it across to deep midwicket with a pull
Pitched up on off, flatter ball, punched to long-off

commentTextItems.html: Pitched up on leg, defended with a straight bat. Off the inside-half it goes towards midwicket
A bit of room and a bit short, cut to backward point
Length on middle and off, a bit of spin again, punched off the back foot to the bowler. Low bounce
Length down leg, goes back in the crease, gets beside the ball and tucks it through square leg
Length on off, punched off the back foot against the spin. To long-on
Pitched up on middle and leg, 81ks, flicked softly towards square leg

commentPostTextItems.html: V. Kalyani : "Isn't Pant defending a rare sight?" Not rare I'd think, maybe a touch lower than most others
Shaurya: "Reading the comms for now...Pant seems to not find his mojo in red ball also...is it so.!?" It was in this over

commentTextItems.html: Big stride forward, reaches forward too and defends the full ball to the bowler's left. Siren goes off again! His fourth no-ball in nearly six overs
97 in! Long-hop outside off. Low bounce and snail-slow off the pitch. Pant swivels gently and mashes a pull over wide long-on

Mid-on took a couple of steps back but it matters not! Pant dances down to collect a full toss around shin-height. Hacks it across the line for a six over wide long-on. His six tally in Tests moves to 96
Length on off, defended to the bowler's left

Dances down, gets close to the pitch and boshes it over long-on. Mid-on in the ring. The angle was bringing the ball in from around the wicket, Pant right behind it. Was 3 metres in front of the stumps when he made contact
Looks to defend the full ball straight, inside edges through square leg

commentPostTextItems.html: shairya: "Can anyone please explain why there is no free hit in test match cricket for a no-ball? Curious to know the reason behind the decision." Guess it's because the value of wickets is higher in Tests. It was suggested by Shane Warne fwiw

dismissalText.commentary: Yashasvi Jaiswal c †Afsar Zazai b Mohammad Saleem 24 (32b 5x4 0x6) SR: 75

dismissalComment.html: And this time Jaiswal's been given, on the field. A strangle down the leg side, what a way to get out! Back of a length and just rears up. Jaiswal should not have gone for another half-hearted flick, but he does right off his hips. Ball angles away and to the keeper

dismissalText.commentary: KL Rahul c Rahmanullah Gurbaz b Ziaur Rahman 100 (165b 11x4 0x6) SR: 60.6

dismissalComment.html: And now Rahul has bunted this straight to short extra cover... Who wouldathunk... Was full and there to be hit, right outside off. He goes for an expansive drive. But the ball flies off the bottom of his bat and flies right into the hands of Gurbaz. A breakthrough against the run of play

dismissalComment.html: And this time Jaiswal's been given, on the field. A strangle down the leg side, what a way to get out! Back of a length and just rears up. Jaiswal should not have gone for another half-hearted flick, but he does right off his hips. Ball angles away and to the keeper

dismissalText.commentary: Sai Sudharsan c †Afsar Zazai b Mohammad Saleem 81 (104b 13x4 0x6) SR: 77.88

dismissalComment.html: Half-volley does the trick. 142ks on fifth stump. Sudharsan was going on one knee and played a flowing cover drive. Slightly late on it. Thickish deflection went to the keeper's left. Unlike a few overs earlier, it was in reach. Nice low catch Zazai
